lines.zh: 我手背在身后，蹦蹦跳跳。
lines.en: Hands behind my back, bouncing along.

lines.zh: 我走两步就转一个小圈。
lines.en: Two steps and a little spin.

lines.zh: 我歪着头往前走，很开心。
lines.en: Head tilted, walking on happily.

lines.zh: 鞋底啪嗒啪嗒响个不停。
lines.en: My shoes keep going pat-pat-pat.
I hum a tune as I walk.

lines.zh: 我从草地这一头走到那头。
lines.en: I walk from one end of the grass to the other.
I hop up on my toes.
I turn around, then turn back.

lines.zh: 我踢着一颗小石子往前走。
lines.en: I kick a pebble along ahead of me.

lines.zh: 我走得比看起来的要远。
lines.en: I get further along than I look.

lines.zh: 我蹦到你前面挡了一下。
lines.en: I bounce in front of you and block the way.

lines.zh: 我走两步，又回头冲你笑。
lines.en: I walk two steps and grin back at you.
I stand there, grinning like a fool.

lines.zh: 橙色的小家伙，在数指头。
lines.en: The little orange fellow counts his fingers.

lines.zh: 我晃来晃去，没什么理由。
lines.en: I sway with no reason at all.

lines.zh: 我在想到底晚饭吃什么。
lines.en: Wondering what dinner will be.

lines.zh: 我哼着歌，调子跑得没边。
lines.en: I hum a tune that wanders off-key.
I scratch the back of my head.

lines.zh: 我盯着天看了一小会儿。
lines.en: I stare at the sky for a bit.

lines.zh: 我是来搞笑的，不带恶意。
lines.en: I'm here to be silly, not cruel.
I blink at you twice.

lines.zh: 我把松开的鞋带系好了。
lines.en: I tied my loose shoelace.

lines.zh: 脑袋空空的，肚子却叫了。
lines.en: My head is empty, but my stomach growls.
I spun a whole circle on the spot.
Arms folded, I nod.
I laughed again, for no reason.
Hi! So you're here too.
You look really serious.
Haven't we met somewhere before?
Want to walk a stretch together?

lines.zh: 我忘了你刚才要做什么。
lines.en: I forgot what you were doing.

lines.zh: 你别就那样站着一动不动。
lines.en: Don't just stand there frozen.
I'm Sunky. Did you get that?

lines.zh: 你手里拿的到底是什么？
lines.en: What exactly is that in your hand?
Come on, give me a smile.
I've nothing much to do today.
Why aren't you saying a word?
Let me think. Hold on.

lines.zh: 你走慢一点，我跟不上了。
lines.en: Slow down. I can't keep up.

lines.zh: 我肚子里有好多话要说。
lines.en: I've got so much to say.

lines.zh: 你会不会觉得我有点怪？
lines.en: Do you think I'm a little weird?
Let's find something to do.

lines.zh: 我记不清下一句是什么了。
lines.en: I can't recall the next line.
You've stood here quite a while.
Don't go. Stay a bit longer.
I was just talking to myself.
Ow! That one really hurts!
I backed off several steps.
I'm holding my own arm.
This isn't fun anymore.
I fell, and got back up.

lines.zh: 摔了一跤，我笑着爬起来。
lines.en: I fall, then scramble up grinning.
My hat got knocked crooked.
My laugh is a bit forced.
Hang on. Let me catch my breath.
I don't want a second one.
Food! What is that thing?
Is that meant for me?
Could I have just a little?
I smell something nice. Very nice.
Hold it up a bit higher!
Anything works. I'm not picky.
That looks really tasty.
I'll share half with you.
Don't take it. I haven't tried it.
I've got something else in my pocket.
Oof! I bumped into you.

lines.zh: 对不起对不起，我没看路。
lines.en: Sorry, sorry. I wasn't looking.
The two of us collided.
You're much harder than me.
I'll take a tiny step back.

lines.zh: 刚才那一下还挺好玩的。
lines.en: That was kind of fun, actually.
Your shoulder blocked me.
I'll just go around the side.
Shall we bump again and see?
My hat got knocked crooked.
I don't really get that.
I've other things on my mind.

lines.zh: 这问题对我来说太难了。
lines.en: That question is too hard for me.

lines.zh: 我是不是该在这里笑一下？
lines.en: Should I laugh here or not?

lines.zh: 我还没想到那么远的事情。
lines.en: I haven't thought that far ahead.
Let's change the subject.

lines.zh: 我不太会回答这种问题。
lines.en: I'm not good at answering that.
I really want to eat something.

lines.zh: 你能不能问得简单一点？
lines.en: Could you ask something simpler?
I ran off laughing.
Oh! I want this one!
Is this thing for me?
Let me pick it up and look.
Do you think this is edible?
I stuff it into my pocket.
It looks a bit dirty.
I can't hold it very steady.
This thing isn't heavy at all.
You dropped it. Here you go.
I'll play with it for a bit.
Oh? Something's moving over there.
I see it! Right over there!

lines.zh: 那究竟是个什么东西呀？
lines.en: What in the world is that?
Should I go over there or not?
It's moving pretty quickly.
I've decided to follow it a while.
Hold on. I'm coming right now.
It sounds noisy over there.

lines.zh: 我们两个一起过去看看。
lines.en: Let's both go and have a look.
It seems to be watching us.

lines.zh: 我把两边的袖子挽起来。
lines.en: I'm rolling up both sleeves.
I'll be serious this time.
I forgot to be careful.
I snapped a branch underfoot.
It shouldn't get far.
Don't get too far from me.
That thing's still up ahead.
I'm laughing while I run.
I'll cut around from the side.
It went into the bushes.
I'm not much good at chasing.
It's heading off to the left.
I tripped just now.
Wait, my shoe came off.
I can keep running.
It's stopped now.
I tiptoe my way over.
I hold my breath and stay quiet.
Am I being too loud?

lines.zh: 我歪头看你，眼睛亮亮的。
lines.en: I tilt my head at you, eyes bright.
Just that one little step.
Should I shout first?
I'm ready to go.
I'll be careful this time.
I'm very close to it now.
It doesn't seem to have looked here.
I'll just bump you!
I have your sleeve; do not think of running.

lines.zh: 这一下其实没什么力气。
lines.en: That didn't have much force in it.
Move over to the side a bit.

lines.zh: 我笑着扑上来，抱你一把。
lines.en: I giggle and pounce, hugging you.

lines.zh: 我一用力把自己绊倒了。
lines.en: I tripped myself over trying.
You're much harder than I thought.
I'm backing off. Sorry.
I headbutt you once.
You're laughing? Then I quit.
Let me try that once more.
That seemed to work a little.
My hand slipped and missed.
You took two or three steps back.
I stepped on your foot.

lines.zh: 我们别再打下去了好吗。
lines.en: Can we stop fighting, please?
Hi! I've made it here!
I think I came the wrong way.
This place is really pretty.
I was running the whole time.
Is there anyone here at all?
I turned all the way around to look.
My shoes are covered in mud.
Someone's calling me, right?
I'll stand here for a moment.
It's darker here than I expected.
I even brought a little food.
So you're here!
I bounce out grinning.
I think I forgot to bring something.

lines.zh: 空气里有股奇怪的味道。
lines.en: There's a strange smell in the air.
I hopped twice on the spot.

lines.zh: 这条路上一个人都没有。
lines.en: There's nobody on this road.
I counted the clouds in the sky.
I've decided to go that way.
You didn't notice me arrive, did you.
Hot! My shoes are burning!

lines.zh: 我从上面一路滚下来了。
lines.en: I rolled all the way down from up there.
Water up my nose. That's awful.
Whoa! I got blown right off my feet.
Something stuck into me.
That flash made my head spin.
I'm hungry. Really hungry.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我吓得跳起来。
lines.en: Lightning struck and I jumped.
I keep falling. Help!
